::: {#exm-contingency-table}
#### Smoking and CHD in the WCGS

```{r}
#| label: cross-smoke-chd
table(Smoking = wcgs$smoke, CHD = wcgs$chd69)
```

Row proportions give the distribution of CHD status
within each smoking group:

```{r}
#| label: cross-smoke-chd-prop
table(Smoking = wcgs$smoke, CHD = wcgs$chd69) |>
  prop.table(margin = 1)
```

@tbl-gtsummary-smoke-chd shows the same counts
as a formatted table.

::: {#tbl-gtsummary-smoke-chd}

```{r}
wcgs |>
  dplyr::select(smoke, chd69) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = chd69) |>
  gtsummary::add_overall() |>
  gtsummary::add_p()
```
